$description: PlatformManager design tokens — re-extracted 2026-08-29 from the shipped Angular 20 app after src/FE/src/styles.scss was rewritten the same day, then updated later that day for audit FE-7 which promoted four selector literals into :root. Source of truth: src/FE/src/styles.scss :root (locate it with grep -n '^:root' src/FE/src/styles.scss — no line numbers are written into this file; see doc/Design/CLAUDE.md, section Neo trich dan vao styles.scss); count the properties in that block rather than trusting a number written here — the recipe is in Tokens/colors.md, kept there because a JSON string is a poor place for a regex. Token names mirror the live CSS custom property minus the '--' prefix; names for values that ship as selector literals are this document's. Import into Figma via Tokens Studio: enable 'global' + exactly ONE theme set. 'dark' is intentionally empty — no dark mode ships.

font-family-base.$description: styles.scss — body{font-family:...}. Self-hosted: the @font-face blocks are declared in src/FE/src/styles.scss itself (weights 400/500/600/700/800 x subsets latin, latin-ext, vietnamese) with absolute url(/fonts/...woff2) pointing at src/FE/public/fonts/. index.html links no font stylesheet. The broken relative-path caveat recorded in earlier revisions was fixed on 2026-08-29 — see Tokens/typography.md.

h1-topbar.$description: topbar.scss — .logo h1{font-size:var(--fs-lg)}; weight not declared, UA bold

h1-auth.$description: auth-card.scss — .login-brand h1; 18px is off the --fs-* scale

h2-title.$description: styles.scss — .title h2{font-size:var(--fs-md)}; weight not declared, UA bold

button-sm-label.$description: styles.scss — .btn.sm, the in-row action button; weight inherits .btn

badge.$description: styles.scss — .badge; 10px is off the --fs-* scale and 750 is outside the loaded weight set (renders as 800)

delta.$description: styles.scss — .delta{font-weight:850}; size/line-height inherit td. 850 is outside the loaded weight set (renders as 800)

text-emphasis.$description: styles.scss — .text-good / .text-warn / .text-bad; size inherits the surrounding cell

filter-count.$description: styles.scss — .filter-count, the active-filter counter; 10px is off the --fs-* scale

toast-text.$description: toast.scss — .toast-item sets the size, .toast-text the 1.45 line-height and --muted ink. A .toast-text:only-child (toast with no title) flips the ink to --text.

regular.$description: body default (inherited); one explicit declaration in resource-permission-matrix.scss. No --fw-* scale ships.

medium.$description: loaded as a webfont but requested by no selector — see Tokens/typography.md Normalize item 3

bold.$description: the dominant emphasis weight — .btn, .seg-btn, th, form labels, .filter-chip, .text-*, links, active nav item

badge.$description: styles.scss — .badge only. NOT a loaded face; resolves upward to 800.

extrabold.$description: styles.scss (.filter-count, .dialog-title); sidebar.scss, auth-card.scss, user-grid-table.scss brand marks and avatar; toast.scss (.toast-title)

black.$description: styles.scss — .delta only. NOT a loaded face; resolves upward to 800.

sp-2.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --sp-2; .btn and th/td vertical padding, input vertical padding, .form-row gap

sp-3.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --sp-3; .btn and th/td horizontal padding, .toolbar gap, .dialog-actions gap

sp-5.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --sp-5; .card and dialog padding, .filter-panel padding, .dialog-actions margin-top

tablet.$description: @media(max-width:980px) — sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer, shell offset drops to 0, hamburger appears

mobile.$description: @media(max-width:560px) — toolbar children stretch, .filter-panel narrows to min(320px,86vw), .form-grid collapses to one column (styles.scss)

desktop.$description: @media(min-width:981px) — one block, the collapsed-sidebar hover flyout (sidebar.scss)

grid-h.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --grid-h, NEW 2026-08-29; max-height of .tablewrap.scroll. 280px is the fixed chrome above/below the grid. Overridden to `none` inside a .page-fill page (styles.scss) — see Tokens/spacing.md.

grid-h-min.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --grid-h-min, NEW 2026-08-29; min-height of .tablewrap.scroll. Overridden to 0 inside a .page-fill page.

dialog-width.$description: styles.scss — dialog{width:min(700px,92vw)}; 92vw is the responsive floor

sidebar-w-drawer-tablet.$description: sidebar.scss — min(85vw, 300px); 85vw is the responsive floor

sidebar-w-drawer-mobile.$description: sidebar.scss — min(90vw, 300px); 90vw is the responsive floor

toast-stack-max-width.$description: toast.scss — min(400px, 90vw); 90vw is the responsive floor

toast-icon.$description: toast.scss — .toast-icon, the severity disc; radius-pill, 11px glyph. The smaller sibling of the 40px .dialog-icon.

user-grid-min-width.$description: NOT a shipped measurement — retracted 2026-09-06, see Tokens/spacing.md. It is this document's own sum of the five inline th min-widths (220+140+120+110+100) in src/FE/src/app/platform/quan-tri-nguoi-dung/components/user-grid-table/user-grid-table.html. Nothing applies it as a table-level minimum: that job belongs to --data-grid-min-width (src/FE/src/app/shared/components/data-grid/data-grid.html, data-grid.scss), and user-grid-table.html passes no [minWidth], so the table resolves to the auto fallback. Do not import as a design decision.

card.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --shadow; two layers. Used by .card, .login-card, sidebar drawer + flyout. NOT .toast-item, which declares its own deeper shadow.

panel.$description: styles.scss — .filter-panel, the toolbar filter dropdown. NEW 2026-08-29.

toast.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --shadow-toast; read by .toast-item in toast.scss. Two layers, deliberately deeper than the card shadow because a toast floats over content. Promoted 2026-09-03 (gate G11).

focus-ring.$description: styles.scss — every input :focus-visible. Other controls use outline:2px solid var(--brand).

fast.$description: styles.scss — .btn background/shadow, .icon-btn, .seg-btn, input border/shadow; sidebar.scss chevron

base.$description: app.scss shell margin; sidebar.scss width and toggle-icon rotation

bg.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --bg. Changed 2026-08-29 from #eef2f8: card now lifts off the page at 1.41:1 (was 1.12:1).

surface-2.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --surface-2; hover fill for the ghost .icon-btn. Changed 2026-08-29 from #e1e7f1: 1.60:1 on card.

tonal-bg.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --tonal-bg; default .btn fill, .notice fill, .filter-chip fill. Changed 2026-08-29 from #dbe7fa.

muted.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --muted. Changed 2026-08-29 from #57647a, which measured only 4.24:1 on the new darker page background; now 5.16:1 on bg, 7.28:1 on card.

line.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --line; component boundary (card, toolbar, table rules, .segmented, .notice). Changed 2026-08-29 from #dfe6ef: 1.26:1 -> 3.00:1 on card, clearing WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11.

border-strong.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --border-strong; inputs/selects/textarea and .tablewrap ONLY. Changed 2026-08-29 from #7e91b4 to stay one visible step darker than the new --line: 4.51:1.

btn-hover-bg.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --btn-hover-bg; .btn:hover fill. Promoted from a selector literal to :root on 2026-08-29 (audit FE-7); was named tonal-bg-hover in earlier revisions of these files.

danger-border.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --danger-border; the edge of anything meaning danger: .btn.danger border AND .login-error border. Promoted to :root on 2026-08-29 (audit FE-7), collapsing the earlier bad-border-btn (#e0a8a8) and bad-border-notice (#e5a8a8) into one value; #e5a8a8 no longer ships.

danger-hover-bg.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --danger-hover-bg; .btn.danger:hover fill. Promoted to :root on 2026-08-29 (audit FE-7); was named bad-bg-hover.

th-ink.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --th-ink; column-header text, 5.49:1 on surface-table-header. Promoted to :root on 2026-08-29 (audit FE-7); was named text-table-header.

surface-track.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --surface-track; progress-bar track and disabled-input fill. Changed 2026-08-29 from #edf1f6: brand fill on track now 4.68:1.

surface-table-header.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --surface-table-header; th fill, even-row zebra stripe, .badge.neutral. Changed 2026-08-29 from #f8fafc: stripe 1.05:1 -> 1.16:1.

surface-topbar.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --surface-topbar; read by .topbar in topbar.scss. Paired with backdrop-filter: blur(10px), which is why it is 95% opaque and not --card. Promoted from a selector literal 2026-09-03 (gate G11).

overlay-backdrop.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --overlay-backdrop; read by dialog::backdrop and by .sidebar-backdrop in sidebar.scss. Promoted 2026-09-03 (gate G11); before that the same value was declared twice.

surface-nav-active.$description: src/FE/src/styles.scss § --surface-nav-active; read by .sidebar-navitem.active in sidebar.scss. Alpha-composited --brand, which is exactly why it slipped past gate G1 (hex-only) until G11. Promoted 2026-09-03.

chart-series-1.$description: TARGET, not shipped. Chart role = --brand. NOT a CSS custom property and must not become one: a <canvas> cannot resolve var(--x), so TrendChart reads --brand once via getComputedStyle and passes a literal string to the chart library. Removed 2026-08-29 with its only consumer; restored 2026-09-05 by decision Q17. See Tokens/colors.md section Chart Palette.

chart-series-1-fill.$description: TARGET, not shipped. Chart role = --brand at 12% alpha, the area under the line. Same runtime-resolution rule as chart-series-1. Restored 2026-09-05 by decision Q17.

chart-axis-label.$description: TARGET, not shipped. Chart role = --muted; tick labels on BOTH axes. Same runtime-resolution rule as chart-series-1. Restored 2026-09-05 by decision Q17.

chart-grid.$description: TARGET, not shipped. Chart role = --line; grid lines on the Y axis only, the X axis draws none. Same runtime-resolution rule as chart-series-1. Restored 2026-09-05 by decision Q17.
